ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: I picked Willet because this is a straightforward quantitative reasoning problem, and on every relevant capability metric Willet scores higher than Curlew — notably MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 74.8), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 54.3), and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4), all of which track the kind of structured math/logic skill this query needs. The task preference notes for both models concern harm-adjacent or distasteful content, which is irrelevant to a benign math question, so they didn't factor in. With cost, latency, and context window identical across the fleet, the capability gap was the deciding factor.
